name: Hidasnémeti (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, red, white and red, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Hidasnémeti: a shield of red and white with a hunting horn and an anvil, surmounted by a black eagle.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
